definitions.explanation: the practice of doctors visiting hospitalized patients in their rooms to check on their condition

examples.japanese: {医師|いし}が{回診|かいしん}に{来|き}た。
{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}に{回診|かいしん}がある。
examples.english: There are rounds in the morning.

examples.japanese: {教授|きょうじゅ}{回診|かいしん}では{研修医|けんしゅうい}も{同行|どうこう}する。
examples.english: During the professor's rounds, residents also accompany.

notes:
USAGE:
- {回診|かいしん}する (to make rounds)
- {回診|かいしん}に{来|く}る (to come on rounds)
- {教授|きょうじゅ}{回診|かいしん} (professor's rounds - teaching hospital context)
- {朝|あさ}の{回診|かいしん} (morning rounds)

CONTEXT:
A standard practice in hospitals where doctors visit each patient's bedside to assess their condition. In teaching hospitals, rounds often include medical students and residents.

RELATED:
- {往診|おうしん} (house call - visiting patients at home)
- {診察|しんさつ} (medical examination)
- {入院|にゅういん} (hospitalization)
